story.so_that: I can track my financial activity and maintain an accurate account balance
story.i_want: view my transactions, add new transactions, and see my current balance in a secure banking application

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Display existing transactions for logged-in account
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is logged in When they view the transaction list Then they see all transactions impacting their account sorted by date descending

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Add new transactions to existing accounts
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is logged in When they submit a new transaction with valid date, payee, and amount Then the transaction is recorded and balance is updated immediately
Given transactions are displayed When a user views the balance Then it reflects the sum of all transactions for their account

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: System handles up to 50-100 transactions displayed at once
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an account has 100 transactions When the user views the transaction list Then all 100 are displayed without pagination and load time is under 2 seconds

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: User session persists across page refreshes
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is logged in When they refresh the page Then they remain logged in and see their transactions

related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given a user is adding a transaction When they leave payee field empty Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Payee is required'
Given a new account with zero transactions When a user logs in Then they see empty transaction list with message 'No transactions yet'
Given a user is adding a transaction When they enter an invalid date format Then the transaction is rejected with error 'Invalid date format'
